description: Clicking the menu bar icon twice quickly does not close the Bitwarden window, or closes it without returning focus.
expected_report: Bitwarden runs in the menu bar only. Clicking the menu bar icon opens the window and moves focus; clicking it again right away should close it and return focus to the previous app (QuickTime Player). Actual: the window stays open, and around 00:09 it closes but focus stays on Bitwarden instead of QuickTime.
difficulty: Tiny menu bar icon, fast double action, the bug is partly about focus (which app is active), visible only in the menu bar app name.
